mechanics.claim: Mel's basic attacks and abilities apply an Overwhelm stack for every separate instance of damage they deal, so a multi-hit ability generates multiple stacks in one cast.
mechanics.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' for each instance of damage they deal to enemies for 5 seconds

mechanics.claim: The first Overwhelm stack applied stores both the flat first-stack damage and the per-stack bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: The first stack also benefits from the per-stack bonus stored damage.

mechanics.claim: If total stored post-mitigation Overwhelm damage exceeds the target's current health and shields, the next stack applied detonates all stored damage as a single burst.
mechanics.quote: If the total {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} stored exceeds the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} and {{tip|shields}}, the next stack applied against them will consume them all to deal the stored damage.

mechanics.claim: Overwhelm damage against minions is reduced to 50% (irrelevant to a champion-target dummy fight).
mechanics.quote: reduced{{ft|to 50%|to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50*0.5;60*0.5;70*0.5;80*0.5|0 to 3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.5}}% AP)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}

mechanics.claim: Every ability cast generates 3 Searing Brilliance stacks, which refresh (not add) on subsequent casts, capping at 9.
mechanics.quote: '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate 3 stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times

mechanics.claim: Mel's next basic attack after gaining Searing Brilliance stacks consumes all of them to fire that many extra magic-damage projectiles at the target, in addition to the normal attack.
mechanics.quote: Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target.

mechanics.claim: On-hit effects (e.g. Guinsoo's Rageblade) do not apply Overwhelm stacks, but effects that inherit the origin basic attack (e.g. Runaan's Hurricane) do.
mechanics.quote: Effects that apply {{tip|on-hit|on-hits}} (e.g {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}) will not apply stacks.
